ana: quick async standup — SDKs / quickstarts / sampleapps / doc fixes

ana: what I did: merged node ESM quickstart, fixed two python snippet typos in the quickstart, updated sampleapp README with env var guidance.
ana: blockers: CI is flaky on mac wheels (packaging/signing step failing intermittently).
ana: today: debug CI, review @sam's PR, patch README nit from @tess.

michael: saw the node ESM merge, nice. confirmed one failing test in sampleapp (serialization edge-case) — i'll pick that up after lunch.

tess: WIP on packaging notes — blocker was missing signing key for mac wheels. @ops-bot any ETA on the key?

ops-bot: DigiSign job #432 finished — signing key uploaded to Vault at `secret/redwood/macos-sign`. ACLs applied to team-devex and eng-packaging.

tess: awesome, re-running mac-pack job now.

sam: quick ping @ana — PR #789 updates sampleapp logging to structured JSON, small risk change. tests pass locally, needs a quick review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/789

ana: on my list, will review after I triage the CI flake. ETA ~2h.

jordan: FYI I added a short note in Console docs about token-level breakdowns and updated the quickstart 'run locally' steps with an example `REDWOOD_API_KEY` export.

michael: tiny nit in quickstart: in `package.json` our script should be `dev` not `start` for the sample. I'll open a 1-line PR.

tess: also saw the README had `npm i redwood@latest` example — should be `@redwood/inference` pkg name. @devex can confirm and i'll patch.

ana: yep it's `@redwood/inference` — i'll update the snippet in-place.

docbot: docs linter report: 3 warnings in `/docs/quickstarts/node` — missing link targets and one code fence lang tag. Run `yarn docs:lint` to reproduce.

sam: re: PR review — if someone can approve the logging change I can cut a patch release afterwards.

michael: i'll take the review now.

michael: left one comment about default log level (suggest `info`). otherwise LGTM :+1:

sam: updated default to `info` and pushed. thanks!

ana: blockers summary: mac wheel signing/CI flake -> resolved; docs lint warnings queued (will fix after lunch); PR #789 needs final approval (michael), then release. I'll follow up in ~2h. Thanks team :heart:

ana: quick action list:
- michael: finish sampleapp serialization fix + review PR#789
- tess: confirm packaging re-run is green
- jordan: small docs PR for token example merged
- sam: prep release once PR approved
- ana: CI triage + docs fixes

ana: if anything urgent ping me or drop a quick DM.
